issues.issue: Does the claimant's fear relate to a Convention ground under section 96?
issues.applicant_position: Fears gang extortion because of his job position.
issues.result_text: Fear is not supported by evidence related to a Convention ground; not a Convention refugee.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face state-agent persecution under section 97(1)(a)?
issues.result_text: Evidence does not implicate El Salvador or its agents, so paragraph 97(1)(a) cannot apply.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face a personalized risk greater than the general population under section 97(1)(b)?
issues.applicant_position: Gang threatens him and everyone; living elsewhere like San Salvador would not reduce the risk.
issues.result_text: Risk is generalized to the population, so no personalized risk under s.97(1)(b) is shown.
